column1: # FROZEN PROMISE-CARRIER RANGES — companion to promise-ledger.tsv.
# Each ledger citation is frozen at line-range granularity with a hash of its
# exact text. File granularity would prevent legitimate changes elsewhere in a
# carrier while still failing to identify the precise promise being protected.
# GENERATED BY scripts/promise-ledger-freeze.py. The script collects every
# `path:line[-line]` citation from promise-ledger.tsv, reads exactly those lines,
# and hashes their newline-joined text without a trailing newline. Paths under
# src/** belong to the product-source set; paths under website/** belong to the
# `--check` verifies coverage in both directions: every cited range is frozen,
# every frozen range is still cited, and every stored hash matches. Hashes guard
# exact text, not meaning; moving a range by inserting lines above it therefore
# The following overlap with p1-file-set.tsv is recomputed on every run:
# The ranges overlapping that set are contract docblocks outside signatures and
# bodies. Other ranges live under website/docs/**, and options classes are not
# carriers because the ledger does not cite them.
# A carrier change is expected when its contract or documentation changes. In
# that case, re-derive the affected ledger rows and regenerate this file; an
# unreviewed silent carrier change is the failure this guard detects.
